# multibayes

**multibayes** provides tools for making directional claims about many
parameters from posterior draws. Direction-agnostic and directional
tests are supported, and can be mixed freely within a single call.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mar-cald/multibayes")
```

## Overview

| Function | Input | What it returns |
|----|----|----|
| [`pd.adjust()`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/pd.adjust.md) | Posterior draws or *pd* vector | Prior-odds threshold *c\** for the probability of direction (per test) |
| [`joint()`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/joint.md) | Posterior draws | Joint probability of the strongest directional claims (default) or simultaneous credible intervals (`interval = TRUE`) |

[`pd.adjust()`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/pd.adjust.md)
asks for a single quantity, `pi0`: an upper bound, set by you, on the
prior probability of the sign opposite to the claimed one. Because the
same `pi0` is used for every parameter, it is also an upper bound on the
expected proportion of parameters in the family that are not on the
claimed side, null effects included, so a judgment about how many null
effects the family could contain can guide its choice. Alternatively,
`p0` is the largest prior probability that no claim in the family is
correct, with `pi0 = p0^(1/m)` for `m` tests that are independent a
priori, so that `pi0` grows with the number of tests. A claim is made
only if it holds under every prior that lowers the prior odds of either
direction by up to `pi0/(1 - pi0)`, which raises the threshold on *pd*
from `c` (default 0.975) to `c*`.

``` r

library(multibayes)
draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(4000, mu = c(1, 0.2, 3), Sigma = diag(3))
colnames(draws) <- c("b1", "b2", "b3")
pd.adjust(draws = draws, pi0 = 0.7)   # claim a direction when pd.adj > c (pd > c*)
joint(draws)                          # joint probability of the top-k claims
```

## Citation

> Calderan, M., Gambarota, F., Finos, L., & Altoè, G. (n.d.). A
> Prior-Odds Adjustment for the Probability of Direction in Multiple
> Testing. Retrieved from <https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/8zwx2_v2>

Run `citation("multibayes")` in R for the full reference (article and
package entries).

# Package index

## Probability of Direction

- [`pd.adjust()`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/pd.adjust.md)
  :

  Prior-odds threshold for the Probability of Direction *pd*

- [`print(`*`<pd_adjust>`*`)`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/print.pd_adjust.md)
  :

  Print method for `pd_adjust` objects

## Joint Posterior

- [`joint()`](https://mar-cald.github.io/multibayes/reference/joint.md)
  : Summaries from joint posterior draws
